title: Kernelised covariance matrices, dimension reduction and imbalanced spectral clustering
abstract: arXiv:2610.33177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Gaussian Mixture Model (abbrv. GMM) is a classic generative model for clustered data, for which spectral clustering based on dimension reduction via PCA has been an effective framework. In this work, we investigate kernelised covariance matrices as an alternative mechanism for dimension reduction and spectral clustering, focusing on truncation kernels that select pairs of data points with suitable separation constraints. The structure of these matrices is motivated by considerations from statistical mechanics of repulsive particle systems. Our approach is particularly relevant for the setting of imbalanced clusters, where the sizes of the largest and smallest clusters have a diverging ratio with the problem size, and existing PCA-based methods turn out to be of limited effectiveness.   We demonstrate efficient dimension reduction and clustering performance of these modified covariance matrices, substantiated by quantitative bounds. I

translated_title: 核化协方差矩阵、降维与不平衡谱聚类
translated_abstract: 高斯混合模型（GMM）是聚类数据的一种经典生成模型，基于PCA降维的谱聚类一直是处理该模型的有效框架。在本工作中，我们研究了核化协方差矩阵，将其作为降维与谱聚类的一种替代机制，重点考察通过合适的分离约束来选择数据点对的截断核。这些矩阵的结构设计受到排斥粒子系统统计力学思想的启发。我们的方法尤其适用于不平衡聚类的场景，即最大聚类与最小聚类的大小之比随问题规模而发散，此时现有的基于PCA的方法效果有限。我们通过定量界限证明了这些改进的协方差矩阵具有高效的降维与聚类性能。
tldr: 提出基于截断核的核化协方差矩阵作为PCA降维的替代方案，在高斯混合模型的不平衡聚类场景下实现了更有效的降维与谱聚类，并给出了定量的理论保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes kernelised covariance matrices based on truncation kernels as an alternative to PCA for dimension reduction, achieving effective spectral clustering on imbalanced Gaussian mixture models with quantitative theoretical guarantees.
